chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about the prayer of the eclipse before the sun sets, and we fear missing the obligatory prayer, so he said: 'Cut it short, perform the obligatory prayer, and return to your eclipse prayer.'
ai.seo_question: How to combine solar eclipse prayer with obligatory prayer if time is short?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of prioritizing the obligatory prayer (Fard) over the supererogatory eclipse prayer (Kusuf) when their times overlap, ensuring the primary duty is not neglected. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential approach of balancing ritual flexibility with the preservation of core obligations, a key theme in the works of Shaykh al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*. The instruction to 'return' to the eclipse prayer highlights the completeness of the ritual rather than treating it as merely a preliminary act.
